what: supplement 4B to the night-1 pre-registration: night 3, ruled on 2026-10-20 (third supplement to the design ticket)
gate: Steam and game processes 0, no other project's GPU container, G8; one NIM on the card at a time; the card work is not timed and may run while the day's CPU work (supplement 4A) is still running

clean_window.when: with no container on the card and nothing else running on the host: after the day's CPU work (supplement 4A) has ended and after the card work that does not need it (arm P, C3, cell R); MIRACL zh P, which needs the zh index, runs on the card after the clean window
clean_window.c1: the default query (k = num_candidates = 100) for all 7,405 HotpotQA questions, timed as in C1 (c = 1, first ten apart), on the same index; the run compared with C1's first run question by question (run_diff.py: identical, same set in another order, different sets, all listed). The index has merged segments since C1 (store size 52.9 GB at C1, 44.2 GB on 2026-10-20 02:01; 32 segments at 01:58), so differences are possible and are reported, not corrected
clean_window.num_candidates: c = 1 latency on 1,000 questions (seed 20261020) for blueprint:100, 200, 400 and es-only:200, 500, 1000, one setting after the other (es_latency_probe.py)
clean_window.zh: the default query for MIRACL zh's 393 questions, timed, compared with the day's untimed run (run_diff.py)

arm_P.what: the Blueprint's knowledge-base path, step by step, each request as the RAG server sends it (p_arm.py; control: results/c2/p_request_control.json, 5 of 5 questions equal for ranking and answer bodies, 5 negative controls unequal)
arm_P.retrieve: C1's run of the default query (night 1, c1_default.trec), the top 100 per question

rerank.settings: the NIM's defaults (the Blueprint's reranker and version, nims.yaml)
rerank.requests: batches of 32 (32, 32, 32, 4), truncate END, the model the NIM lists; the 10 highest logits over all batches, highest first

answer.settings: as supplement 3 (NVFP4 profile, the NIM's defaults, concurrency from GET /metrics kv_cache_max_concurrency, at most 32)
answer.request: the request of arm O with the reranked 10 passages (answer_arms.py, arm O builder); final answer and token rules as supplement 3

arm_P.scores: contains (main), F1, EM, refusals, finish reasons, Wilson 95%; paired exact McNemar P against N and P against O on the same 7,405 questions; the share of questions whose 10 passages hold both supporting passages / one / none

expectation.P_contains: between O's 0.728 and N's 0.304, nearer O

C3.retrieve: results/c2/c3_retrieval.json: the kNN query with a filter inside the kNN clause leaving out each question's two supporting passages (311 supporting passages removed from the unfiltered top 100; none left)
C3.then: rerank and answer as arm P
C3.measured: refusal by pattern (rag_eval.py) with Wilson 95%%; contains against the gold answer (an answer from the model's own knowledge); 50 answers (seed 20261020) labelled by hand as refusal / answers anyway / other before the pattern's verdict is looked at, and the agreement reported
C3.expectation: most answers are not refusals, given the RAG prompt's rule to answer when the context holds relevant data and the reasoning model; confidence low

zh_P.retrieve: the day's default run on the zh index
zh_P.then: rerank and answer as arm P (the Blueprint's English prompts, as shipped)
zh_P.measured: the share of questions whose 10 passages hold a passage judged relevant (qrels relevance > 0), Wilson 95%; refusals by pattern; finish reasons. MIRACL has no answer strings: no answer score
zh_P.expectation: share of questions with a judged-relevant passage among the 10 between 0.6 and 0.9; confidence low

cell_R.what: Nano with the reasoning parser the NIM 2.0.12 documentation gives for reasoning models: the container command-line argument --reasoning-parser nemotron_v3 (docs.nvidia.com/nim/large-language-models/2.0.12/ai-assistant-integrations/codex-cli.html: 'Reasoning models emit thinking tokens. Without a parser, that text lands in the assistant message'; its example serves a Nemotron 3 model with nemotron_v3; parser names are model-specific)
cell_R.questions: the 200 of the C3 sample with arm P's reranked passages (not filtered)
cell_R.measured: the reasoning separated (reasoning_content) or not; reasoning tokens per answer and the share at most 256; whether the content still holds '</think>' or reasoning (what the Blueprint would show); contains on the same 200 against arm P
cell_R.expectation: the reasoning comes apart from the answer; whether the 256 budget then holds is open; confidence low

branches.not_finished_by_STOP_AT: 07:45 or the owner's later time: the step stops, the progress file says where; the next night continues from the files
branches.a_NIM_does_not_start: its log is the result; that step stops, the others go on
